name: In silico toxicology multi-label benchmarking
description: A comprehensive evaluation comparing multi-label classification methods on chemical toxicity datasets to assess predictive performance.
reputation: Used in cheminformatics and computational toxicology research for benchmarking multi-label predictors; moderate adoption in the toxicology ML community.
notes: Datasets often suffer from strong class imbalance, label noise and small sample sizes; results can be sensitive to preprocessing and descriptor selection. Non-LLM benchmark; contamination risk if proprietary assay data overlap with training sources.
